about: Effects and styles of the Element Forge app (22.10.2026; spirit styles 03.11.). Every style is a set of values for the one workflow, by setting name (element_forge.settings.json); the canvas and the timeline add the clip, the points, the frame, the direction and the timing. Values come from the test runs named in ref (one_tests.py). placement: point = element on black hanging on point A (frame = element size), window = crop window around point A (frame = window, origin inside it), ab = between point A and B, frame = the whole picture, object = follows the clicked object by itself, none = no frame. win and emitter are fractions (window of the clip's shorter side, origin inside the window). prompt.what_plain: the same thing without colour or size words, used once the user changes the Look block (so a chosen look never contradicts the fixed part). look_tune: the style's light on the scene, element strength and glow (EF App Run shot app look; spirit styles 03.11.).
tail_on_black: Filmed on a pure black background, live-action, realistic, high detail.

inpaint.about: Every AI effect can be made as a layer on black or painted into the clip (inpaint). These are the settings a kind gets when it is painted in; the style's own settings and Advanced win. Glowing effects are keyed by their colour and added, solid ones (smoke, debris, liquid, snow) are taken as any change and laid over. No light pass: the light is in the picture already. Sigmas start at the tested default 0.909. Fire starts from the flame made on black first (23.10., pod: painted in from scratch LTX kept the forest and drew no flame, also from 0.975 and 0.9875; from the element it burns at the point and lights the ground around it). Lightning starts at 0.975 (23.10., pod: between the hands from 0.909 a small spark, from 0.975 a clear jagged arc, 0.15 -> 0.71 % of the pixels changed). Styles name no object (25.10.: no body parts as defaults); painted in between two points, the Effect step asks for the object word in Position (23.10.: from two clicks alone the track lost the hands and nothing was painted, 0.0 %; with the word hand 0.97 %, and magic flow between the hands appeared).
